title: What is Electric Field?
text: Electric field (E) is the force per unit positive test charge at a point: E = F/q. Its unit is N/C or equivalently V/m.

title: Field Due to Point Charge
text: For a point charge Q, the field at distance r is E = kQ/r². This follows from Coulomb's Law divided by the test charge.

title: Direction of Field
text: Electric field vectors point away from positive charges and toward negative charges. For this positive charge, the field points radially outward.
